h1: Interior design project example: a 3-room (two-bedroom) apartment in just 47 m²

blocks.text: Interior design project example: a 3-room (two-bedroom) apartment in just 47 m²

parts.html: A client came to our studio with a challenging task: to organize a living space for a young family in just 47 m². We needed to plan a living room combined with a kitchen, a convenient bathroom, a spacious children’s room with a study area, and a cozy bedroom.

The living room and kitchen were combined into a single bright space for the family and guests. The bathroom was positioned so that it is accessible from every room. In the children’s room, the balcony was joined to the living area, and spaces for sleeping, playing, and studying were organized with multifunctional furniture and storage systems. Thanks to zoning and the color palette, the compact parents’ bedroom turned out cozy and private.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) rose to the challenge, transforming 47 m² into a convenient, stylish, and functional space for a young family.
